verdict.rationale: Ultrametric stores hosted company records, runs, and decisions, so retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence covers saving, resuming, revisions, and history (docs-13, docs-16, docs-17) but documents no way to delete records or set retention periods. The note that `--path` context stays local during retrieval (docs-29) concerns data locality, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
